args.content:
## Hawaii Vacation Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight summer clothing
- Swimwear
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Hiking boots
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler nights
- Beach cover-up
- Towels

### Essentials
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ or higher)
- Sunglasses
- Beach hat
- Water bottle
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Insect repellent

### Travel Documents
- Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel confirmation
- Car rental documents (if applicable)

### Electronics
- Smartphone and charger
- Power bank
- Travel adapter
- Camera and extra batteries

### Miscellaneous
- Snorkeling gear (if renting)
- Beach towel
- Umbrella or rain jacket
- First-aid kit
- Travel journal or notebook
